```plato

    // The error quadric of every vertex: the area-weighted sum over the triangles
    // that use it. Quadratic in vertex count times face count.
    VertexQuadrics(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<Quadric>
        => self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v => self.Faces.Count.MapRange(f => f)
            .Reduce(Quadric.ZeroQuadric, (q, f) =>
                self.Faces[f].HasVertex(VertexIndex(v))
                    ? q.Add(TriangleQuadric(self.Triangle(FaceIndex(f))))
                    : q));
```
